# Rapid Squares

> Rapid Squares sells aerial roof measurement reports and hail and storm history reports for any address in the United States and Canada. Roofers, insurance adjusters and contractors search an address, confirm the roof on an aerial map, and get a branded PDF report by email. Prices are in US dollars; a subscription ($100 a month or $1,000 a year, with a 30-day free trial) lowers the price of every report.

## Reports

- [Premium Residential Roof Report](https://rapidsquares.com/residential-roof-report): a full aerial measurement of a house (and its detached garage, or every building): total area and roofing squares, the pitch of every face, every eave, rake, ridge, hip, valley and flashing length, a waste factor table from 0% to 24%, and length, area and pitch diagrams. Delivered in under 2 hours. $12, or $7 with a subscription; new accounts get their first Premium reports free. Optional Xactimate ESX file for $5.
- [Rapid Squares](https://rapidsquares.com/rapid-squares): every building outlined on an aerial photo, with its roofing squares at an estimated pitch and at every pitch from 1/12 to 12/12, with 10%, 12% and 15% waste, plus footprint and perimeter. One-page PDF, delivered in under 30 minutes. $8, or $5 with a subscription. No ESX file.
- [Commercial Roof Report](https://rapidsquares.com/commercial-roof-report): flat and low-slope roofs, every building on the property: total area and squares, parapet walls, eaves and wall flashing, pitch breakdown, waste factor table and diagrams. Usually delivered in about 8 hours. $30, or $25 with a subscription. Optional Xactimate ESX file for $5.
- [Hail and Storm History Report](https://rapidsquares.com/hail-storm-report): five years of hail, wind and tornado history at an address and within 1, 3 and 5 miles, from NOAA and National Weather Service records, with a damage-chance rating and a date of loss check. Five PDFs (Homeowner Storm Summary, Hail Verification, Wind Verification, Date of Loss, Weather History), ready in seconds. $5, free with a subscription.

## Facts

- A roofing square is 100 square feet of roof surface.
- Reports carry the ordering company's logo, colors and contact details.
- Reports are remote estimates from aerial imagery; verify on site for complex roofs.
- Order without an account at https://rapidsquares.com/order.html (an account is made at checkout). Teams can share one account with roles and permissions.
- Contact: brett@rapidsquares.com
